title: mlomix pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

dataset.description: Unique dataset identifier, without spaces, e.g. sequencing run id, project identifier, etc.
dataset.errorMessage: Dataset name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

batch.description: Batch identifier, without spaces. Only required for model training with samples from multiple sequencing batches.

class.description: Class/subtype label for the sample. Only required for model training or validation.

data_silo.description: Data silo identifier, e.g. 'train', 'test', 'validation'. Only used for model training.

gex_feature_counts_file.description: Path to the gene expression feature counts file, if available for this sample. The file should be tab-delimited with the first column containing gene identifiers and the second column containing raw counts.
gex_feature_counts_file.errorMessage: gex_feature_counts_file must be a valid file path

dnam_beta_matrix_file.description: Path to the DNA methylation beta matrix file, if available for this sample. The file should be tab-delimited with the first column containing probe identifiers and the second column containing beta values.
dnam_beta_matrix_file.errorMessage: dnam_beta_matrix_file must be a valid file path

dnam_pvals_file.description: Path to the DNA methylation p-values file, if available for this sample. The file should be tab-delimited with the first column containing probe identifiers and the second column containing p-values.
dnam_pvals_file.errorMessage: dnam_pvals_file must be a valid file path

sentrix_id.description: Sentrix ID, e.g. the ID of the array slide. Only required if processing raw DNA methylation data from Illumina arrays (IDAT).
sentrix_id.errorMessage: sentrix_id must be a string or integer

sentrix_position.description: Sentrix position, e.g. the position of the array slide. Only required if processing raw DNA methylation data from Illumina arrays (IDAT).

idats_basename.description: Path to directory containing *_Red.idat and *_Grn.idat files. Only required if processing raw DNA methylation data from Illumina arrays (IDAT).
idats_basename.errorMessage: idats_basename must be a valid directory path
